The short version of SRE & Reliability Engineering: named metrics, named owners, evidence that travels. The sections below walk through the pattern, the components and the commitments.

blocks.title: Golden-path platform topology — SRE & Reliability Engineering
blocks.note: What runs at the edge is chosen by physics, not fashion: latency, bandwidth and autonomy constraints decide placement — and the fleet is managed as one estate.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind SRE & Reliability Engineering is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a SRE & Reliability Engineering capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.
